content:
maya: Heads-up — running a controlled one-to-one compare across models using the replay harness. Goal: identical prompts, stop tokens, decoding params, and tokenizer-aligned inputs. Anyone seeing regressions?

liam: SG. Which models / quantization are in scope? :eyes:

maya: baseline set = open-llama-13b-q4, llama-13b-fp16. small sanity on vicuna-13b. Decoding params are identical for all runs: temp=0.0, top_p=0.95, max_tokens=128, stop=["</s>"].

liam: ack. also planning to toggle kernel picker? heuristic vs force?

maya: yes — we'll flip `--kernel-policy=auto` vs `--kernel-policy=force_fast_gemm`. Batching matrix: [1,4,16]. KV modes: `replay` (real session prefixes) vs `synth` (generated prefixes). We need KV warmup parity.

sarah: for tokenizer alignment I'll run `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --seed 42` on each model to verify token counts for the canonical prompts. found whitespace handling diffs before.

alex: small harness tweak: strip trailing newline before tokenization to avoid off-by-one. PR: https://rwd/repo/pull/987

maya: example run command I'm using:
```
./harness/run_compare \
  --replay sessions/2025-11-01.rec \
  --models "open-llama-13b-q4,llama-13b-fp16" \
  --decoding "temp=0,top_p=0.95,max_tokens=128,stopseq=</s>" \
  --kernel-policy auto \
  --batch-sizes 1,4,16 \
  --kv-mode replay
```

liam: nice. let's capture perf counters: p50,p90,p99, tokens/sec, mem-alloc, kernel-ids used per request.

benchmark-bot: run queued by maya at 2050012325. Job id: 4721.

benchmark-bot: run 4721 finished at 2050012380. Summary:
- model open-llama-13b-q4: p50=32ms p90=120ms p99=260ms tokens/s=470 kernel_ids=[fast_gemm,vect4]
- model llama-13b-fp16: p50=28ms p90=110ms p99=240ms tokens/s=520 kernel_ids=[fmha_opt,fast_gemm]
- batch=16 shows 2.3x throughput gain but p90 increases ~1.6x for q4
- KV warmup mismatch observed: replay sessions had avg prefix 60 tokens; synth used 128 — inflated q4 p99.

sarah: that KV warmup mismatch is the regression we suspected. Recommend forcing same prefix length for synth runs.

maya: agreed. I re-ran synth with `--synth-prefix 60`. New job 4722.

benchmark-bot: run 4722 finished at 2050012405. Summary:
- q4 p99 decreased from 260ms -> 210ms
- tokens/s improved ~12%
- kernel selection shifted: q4 used vect4 more when prefix=60; fmha_opt remained dominant on fp16.

alex: interesting — kernel picker does use prefix length distribution to pick kernels. We should log kernel decision metrics per request.

liam: also check decode determinism: compare outputs (hash of text) across runs. Any text diffs?

maya: diffed outputs for 1000 prompts: 0 mismatches when temp=0 and same tokenizer; 7 mismatches when we had trailing newline bug. Fixed by PR.

sarah: recording perf regression note: earlier nightly saw q4 p90 jump ~20% after recent batching change. Seems tied to `--batch_collapse` default=true. Disabling collapse returns prior perf.

maya: action items:
- liam to add kernel-decision telemetry per request (metrics + top-2 kernel candidates)
- alex to ensure tokenizer canonicalization in harness
- sarah to run full apples-to-apples sweep with synth and replay aligned (prefix, decoding, tokenization) and paste artifacts
- maya to file perf postmortem if regression persists

liam: on it. Will open a short RFC for telemetry shape.

maya: thanks everyone. Will drop final artifacts in #perf-artifacts and link PRs. :thumbsup:
